description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in Porcelan at Rezidenca Colombo. It is organized by 1 common living and cooking area, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and 2 balconies. The apartment is located on the 7th floor of a well-managed building with an elevator. The apartment has a buffet and 1 parking spot with an extra price of 25,000 Euros. Has regular mortgage documentation. For more information, contact us.
